tool_input.content:
name: "Format Terraform Plan"
description: "Strips noise from terraform plan, keeps only changes, and truncates for GitHub outputs"

inputs:
  plan_file:
    description: "Path to the plan output text file"
    required: true
  max_length:
    description: "Maximum length before truncation"
    required: false
    default: "55000"

outputs:
  plan_formatted:
    description: "Formatted plan output (changes only)"
    value: ${{ steps.format.outputs.plan_formatted }}
  plan_truncated:
    description: "Whether the plan was truncated"
    value: ${{ steps.format.outputs.was_truncated }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - name: Format Plan
      id: format
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # Strip refreshing/reading noise, keep only the changes
        PLAN_CHANGES=$(sed -n '/Terraform used the selected providers/,$ p' "${{ inputs.plan_file }}")

        # Fallback: if that marker isn't found, try "Terraform will perform"
        if [ -z "$PLAN_CHANGES" ]; then
          PLAN_CHANGES=$(sed -n '/Terraform will perform the following actions/,$ p' "${{ inputs.plan_file }}")
        fi

        # Fallback: if still empty, try "No changes" or "Plan:" summary
        if [ -z "$PLAN_CHANGES" ]; then
          PLAN_CHANGES=$(grep -E '(No changes|Plan:|Error|Warning)' "${{ inputs.plan_file }}" || true)
        fi

        # Final fallback: strip Refreshing/Reading lines manually
        if [ -z "$PLAN_CHANGES" ]; then
          PLAN_CHANGES=$(grep -v -E '(Refreshing state\.\.\.|: Reading\.\.\.|: Read complete after)' "${{ inputs.plan_file }}" || true)
        fi

        MAX_LENGTH=${{ inputs.max_length }}
        PLAN_LENGTH=${#PLAN_CHANGES}
        WAS_TRUNCATED="false"

        if [ "$PLAN_LENGTH" -gt "$MAX_LENGTH" ]; then
          PLAN_CHANGES="${PLAN_CHANGES:0:$MAX_LENGTH}"
          WAS_TRUNCATED="true"
        fi

        echo "was_truncated=${WAS_TRUNCATED}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

        {
          echo 'plan_formatted<<PLAN_EOF'
          echo "$PLAN_CHANGES"
          if [ "$WAS_TRUNCATED" == "true" ]; then
            echo ""
            echo "... (truncated — view full plan in workflow logs)"
          fi
          echo 'PLAN_EOF'
        } >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

        # Step summary always gets the full cleaned plan
        echo "## Terraform Plan" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```hcl' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo "$PLAN_CHANGES" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

        if [ "$WAS_TRUNCATED" == "true" ]; then
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "> Plan was truncated in PR comment. Full plan available in workflow logs." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
        fi

tool_input.new_string:
- name: Format Plan
        id: format-plan
        uses: NationalServicesGroup/nsg-github-actions/terraform-format-plan@main
        with:
          plan_file: ${{ inputs.working_directory }}/plan.txt

      - name: Comment PR with Plan
        uses: actions/github-script@v8
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        with:
          script: |
            const plan = `${{ steps.format-plan.outputs.plan_formatted }}`;

            const output = `### Terraform Plan: \`${{ matrix.environment }}\`

            <details>
            <summary>Show Plan</summary>

            \`\`\`hcl
            ${plan}
            \`\`\`

            </details>

            *Pushed by: @${{ github.actor }}, Action: \`${{ github.event_name }}\`*`;

            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: output
            });
